  CAST(o.create_time AS VARCHAR) AS create_time,
  CAST(o.audit_time AS VARCHAR) AS audit_time,

  CAST(o.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,

  json_extract_string(u.d, '$.item_code') AS item_code,
